text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home after a day out with
Nishino
Flower...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah! Trainer, look over there...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow her line of sight and spot a little
boy
crouched down by the riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Is he alone? It's going to be dark soon.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer. Can I go see if he's okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So you broke your mother's
favorite cup.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh... I know she's gonna be really, really mad at me... so... so I... Sob...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's okay. You got scared and left home
without
telling anyone, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Here, watch this. I'll show you something
cool.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea where she was hiding
them, but
Nishino Flower pulls out some
small beanbags and
tosses them up in
the air.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then she catches them gracefully and
quickly
tosses them up again in tall,
beautiful arcs...

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: W-wow! Are you a circus performer?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I'm not done yet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower moves around vigorously,
spinning
and hopping to and fro, all
while keeping the
beanbags dancing in
the air.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing! You must be some
kind of pro
juggler!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ It's nice to see you smiling. Now
then...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready to go home to your mom?
If you're
still scared, we can tag along
and apologize with
you. I'm sure she's
worried sick about you.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're about to accompany the boy back
to his
house when...
There you are!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: M-mom!

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad you're safe!
I'm terribly sorry
for the trouble my son has
caused!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Don't you have something to say to
your mom?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: ...Right.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Mom... I'm really sorry... but I broke your
cup.

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You silly boy! You're far more important
to me
than some old cup! Oh, I've been
beside myself
with worry!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Sob... Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We see them off before once again
heading back
to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming with me to help
that boy,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm glad they were able to make up.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't know about that... All I did was
talk to
him like I would with anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But... I'm happy to know that's how you
saw me,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower's tender side leaves a
lasting
impression on me as we continue
following the
path home.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty confident in my skills,
actually.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
When I was younger, my mom used to
cheer me
up by juggling whenever I
cried.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! The last time I showed her my
juggling, she
was really stunned by how
good I'd gotten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower's hidden talent leaves a
lasting
impression on me as we continue
following the
path home.
